title: Reference: $1,200 up to a 60-pt stop + room 100%
question: Owner order 2026-10-18: an MFFU 50K eval must be passed within 10 sessions; maximise P(pass in 10) and minimise $91.80 / P(pass in 10).
verdict: Big fixed $ ($1,200 up to 60 pts, all the room): A's pass rate with 24-36% failing. 50K: H1 starts (pick) pass/fail/open within 10 sessions 59.7/24.4/15.9% (n 119), within 20 68.8/31.2%, cost per 2-week pass $154.0, worst day $-1,011, max at risk $1,000; H2 starts (check) pass/fail/open within 10 sessions 53.6/29.0/17.4% (n 69), within 20 52.5/47.5%, cost per 2-week pass $171.0, worst day $-1,009, max at risk $997; 2026 pass/fail/open within 10 sessions 54.8/28.9/16.3% (n 197), within 20 57.2/42.8%, cost per 2-week pass $168.0, worst day $-1,011, max at risk $1,000; Monte Carlo 4,000 x 20 sessions (5-session blocks): H1 51.0/35.7/13.3, H2 55.6/29.6/14.8; 2021-25 reference (5m) 17.4/45.7. Back to back (new eval after a pass, a fail or 10 sessions): 2026 19 passes in 39 evals ($188 a pass), 2021-25 29 in 150 ($475). 25K ($63, every $ halved): H1 47.9/29.4, H2 52.2/29.0, cost per 2-week pass H1 $132.0 / H2 $121.0.
method: LIT replay (engine/lit.py run_x, the same code as the live loop engine/lit_live.py): 2026 entries on 1-minute bars, 2021-25 on 5-minute bars (reference); live sizing + weekly stop; costs included
